# Blind injection benchmark: tables (generated by `scripts/benchmark_report.py`)

Before: code at commit ef5d02a (v0.4.9). After: neighbour-pull rule (this branch). Same 3300 trials, same random seed, same spots. TP = injected movers recovered as confirmed; FP = confirmed movers that are neither the injection nor present before injecting; recall = TP / n; precision = TP / (TP + FP); rate error = median absolute relative error of the recovered speed.
